description: The manufacturer's agent files a target market statement for an ISIN its Legal Entity Identifier issues, under its filer identity (Authorization: Bearer <filer value>). The door checks shape, identity, LEI and subject, stores the statement at the subject's home node as the next version (immutable; a change is a new version that supersedes the last), signs it on the filer's behalf and under the node's record key, and receipts the filing with the door as writer and the filer as caller. Free.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer's LEI (it must be the filer identity's LEI and, for a live subject, the LEI on the subject's record).

statement.description: manufacturer_name, markets, positive_target_market, negative_target_market, distribution_strategy, product_scope_statement, documentation, assessments, source (and supersedes, optional: the version it replaces). The door adds subject, manufacturer, version, filed_at, supersedes, filer, kid, sig, node, node_sig.

subject.description: The ISIN (TEST:<ISIN-shaped> for the test namespace).

name: file_target_market
title: File a target market statement
